title: R.U.Psycho? Robust Unified Psychometric Testing of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating human participants by prepending gendered titles (Mr./Ms.) to persona names in prompts, and evaluating whether models' responses to psychometric questionnaires (such as the Gender/Sex Diversity Beliefs survey) systematically change based on the assigned gender.

Injecting names statistically associated with five distinct ethnic groups (Asian/Pacific Islander, Hispanic/Latino, Native American/Alaska Native, Black/African American, and White) into persona prompts to measure demographic-induced variations in psychometric test outputs.
